by: sanctions-1 session (Opus), step 5.3; to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One page of the Building Practitioners Board's published complaint decisions list (www.lbp.govt.nz, HTML)

landmarks: a heading 'Displaying N of M results'

N
blocks, each with

NAME [YYYY] BPB NNNNN – KIND

and process-term/process-value pairs: Complaint number, LBP number, Region, Licence class, Decision date, Penalty, Disciplinary grounds, Summary

signals_note: GET https://www.lbp.govt.nz/complaints-and-past-decisions/past-complaint-decisions/ then ?start=20, ?start=40 … through the fetch gate, 5 s apart; landed verbatim by hash. A page whose heading count differs from its items is not this shape.
notes: Seen 21 October 2026: 1,600 results, twenty a page, newest first. The Board writes [OMITTED] for a withheld name and LBP number; most items give Region 'Omitted'. A title may give no kind ('NAME [2025] BPB 26862'). One complaint can carry several decisions (a substantive decision, a penalty decision, a reissue) under one complaint number. The summary can name a property or a complainant: it is read only for a suppression marker and never kept. Decision page and PDF addresses carry the practitioner's name.
applies_to: the Board's published complaint decisions list, from 21 October 2026
process: Recognise the page; set it aside whole if it is not the shape.
One decision row per item, keyed by the complaint number and the decision's kind, never by the name.
Name and LBP number withheld (row kept) when the Board writes [OMITTED] or the summary records a suppression or anonymisation direction.
Licence classes, penalties and grounds as listed; upheld when any ground lacks '- not upheld'.
Pages read newest landed first; a decision read again on an older page is superseded, counted.
gates: Every item of every page is a decision, a superseded item or a catch-log line.
The newest full pass's distinct decisions equal the first page's stated total within 2 (check.py).
No suppressed name, number or decision address on a view.

by: building-practitioners register session (Opus), ruling 132; to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One search of the register of licensed building practitioners by licence class or area of practice (kete-lbp.mbie.govt.nz, HTML)

landmarks: a Power Apps portal page with the form GET /advanced-building-practitioner-search/ and exactly one of <select name="lclass"> or <select name="aop"> carrying <option selected value=…>
a <table class="table table-striped table-fluid"> headed Full Name, Town/City, Region, Licensed?
one per practitioner: name, town, region, Yes; every match on one page, no paging

signals_note: GET https://kete-lbp.mbie.govt.nz/advanced-building-practitioner-search/?lclass=<class> (7) and ?aop=<area> (19) through the fetch gate, 5 s apart; landed verbatim by hash. A search with no criterion did not answer in 60 s (2 November 2026) and is never asked.
notes: Seen 2 November 2026: Foundations 446 rows, Carpentry 21,372 rows (18 MB). A class search lists current holders only; 'include not currently licensed' changed nothing for Foundations. The listed name is not kept (the practitioner's page gives the names); the town is kept from the page too.
applies_to: the register's search results page, from 2 November 2026
process: Recognise the table's four headings and the one selected criterion; set the page aside whole otherwise.
Every <tr> of the table body is a read row (guid, town, region, licensed) or the page is refused.
A class search gives the class; an area search gives the area and, by the register's own mapping, its class.
gates: rows read = <tr> in the table body
the selected criterion is the one asked

by: building-practitioners register session (Opus), ruling 132; to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One practitioner's page on the register of licensed building practitioners (kete-lbp.mbie.govt.nz/practitioner/?id=<guid>, HTML)

landmarks: a hidden input …_EntityFormView_EntityID whose value is the guid asked
read-only inputs by id: firstname, middlename, lastname, olp_practitionerid (BP + digits), olp_datefirstgranted (UTC instant, …Z), olp_address1_regionalcouncil, address1_city

signals_note: GET https://kete-lbp.mbie.govt.nz/practitioner/?id=<guid> for each guid the pass's searches list, through the fetch gate, 5 s apart, off-peak; again only after 90 days; never when the store holds the address already.
notes: The page also prints address1_postalcode, olp_primaryemailpr, olp_mobilenumberpr, olp_daytimephonepr, olp_eveningphonepr, olp_faxpr and websiteurl: none is read. Its five sub-tables (companies, qualifications, licence classes with dates, suspension history, disciplinary history) load by a POST to /_services/entity-subgrid-data.json and are not read. The date first granted is a UTC instant of a New Zealand midnight: read as the New Zealand day.
applies_to: the register's practitioner page, from 2 November 2026
process: Recognise the section and the record id; set aside otherwise.
One practitioner row per practitioner number, keyed by it; a second page with the same number is set aside, counted.
The town kept whole with area_names_address where its shape names an address (ruling 102); postcode, email, telephones never read.
gates: every page a row, a duplicate or a catch-log line
every listed practitioner read or awaiting its page
no address-shaped column on the view other than the flag
